text:
Alex Chen: kicking off a config-only change for /v1/generate now — adjusting batching + timeouts + routing weights. No model version change.
Alex Chen: change summary:
```
max_batch_size: 64 -> 32
request_timeout: 12s -> 8s
routing_weights: geo-east: 0.45 -> 0.60, geo-west: 0.55 -> 0.40
soft_qps_limit: 150 -> 120
kv_prefix_cache_ttl: 30m -> 45m
```
Alex Chen: planning a 5% canary for 20m during change window (16:00-18:00 UTC). Runbook linked: https://runbooks.internal/release/microconfig-batching
deploy-bot: canary started at 5472101234 for route /v1/generate (5% traffic). CanaryID: canary-4472. Observability checks enabled. :rocket:
Jamie Ortega: quick ask — confirm we are NOT changing model binaries or quantization here? want to pin that explicitly. :eyes:
Alex Chen: correct — config-only. model pinned to v3.2.0 (no rollout).
Priya Nair: metrics to watch: p50/p95 latency, request_error_rate, queue_length, gpu_mem_evictions, batch_fill_rate. Thresholds: p95 +120ms, errors >0.8% sustained 10m, evictions >=3/node in 10m.
Morgan Lee: I'll watch dashboards and traces. Ping me if p95 > +80ms. I'll have oncall on standby. :thumbsup:
Riley Brooks: add an automated rollback snippet to the thread in case we hit evictions or errors:
```
# rollback to previous config
deployctl promote --canary canary-4472 --rollback --reason "eviction/error spike"
```
Samira Patel: hold canary at 5% for at least 25m. If stable, promote to 25% for 30m, then full. No autopromote beyond 25% without sign-off. Also notify sales if latency change >100ms for VIP tenants.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics @ +15m: p95 latency delta +42ms, p50 -3ms, error_rate 0.22%, avg_batch_size down 12%, queue_length decreased. gpu_mem_evictions: 0 in last 15m. Suggest: healthy -> consider promote to 25%.
Samira Patel: agree to promote to 25% for 30m. Morgan, Riley stay on watch.
deploy-bot: promotion to 25% started at 5472103000 for canary-4472. Monitoring active.
Alex Chen: note — we tightened request_timeout to 8s which will drop some tail requests; expected slight p95 shift but better overall throughput.
deploy-bot: Alert: at 5472107600 detected tail-latency spikes and GPU kernel retries on 2 nodes. eviction_count increased to 5 on node-gpu-12 in 10m. Rolling back canary canary-4472 automatically (policy: eviction_threshold).
Samira Patel: acknowledged. Automatic rollback triggered — good. Anyone seeing downstream customer impact?
Morgan Lee: dashboards show a brief spike in 503s for two tenants, lasted ~4m, now back to baseline after rollback. No paging events.
Jamie Ortega: thanks — reaffirming no model change so fallback is clean. Please capture incident notes.
Alex Chen: rollback complete, routing weights restored, batching/timeouts reverted to previous values. Will open a short postmortem doc and iterate on a softer timeout change.
Samira Patel: thanks team. Lessons: 1) simulate tighter timeouts in staging under mixed load, 2) gate mem-eviction signals earlier (eviction >=2 -> pause). I'll add to the postmortem checklist. :memo:
deploy-bot: Canary canary-4472 rolled back at 5472107890. Thread closed.
